hero.name: Jesús Molano
hero.tagline: Any framework, any road. I'm the one at the wheel.
hero.scrollHint: Scroll to drive into the city
hero.sceneLabel: Sunset drive over a causeway toward a neon city skyline, palm trees on both sides
hero.speaker: Jesús
lines: Who's the guy at the wheel? Jesús. Frontend engineer. Vue and Nuxt by heart. Everything else? Like Mr. Wolf, he solves problems.
Plot twist? He used to be a soldier, taking orders. Now he's a code nerd who finally gets to give them… to an AI.
Favourite film? The Godfather. Favourite series? The Sopranos. Code reviews? He makes you an offer you can't refuse.
Music? The same playlist since he was sixteen. He calls it backwards compatibility.
Where are we headed? The city, where his CV doesn't live in a PDF. It's up in neon, billboard after billboard.

tips: The car never moves. The world does. Nobody tell the car.
Reading the docs restores full health.
Every palm tree here is procedural. The jokes are handmade.
The city is still loading. Like most side projects.
Turn the music on. The palms sway better with funk.
